ticket_types.name: General Support
ticket_types.description: Get help with general server questions

applications.name: Beta Tester Application
applications.description: Apply to test Darklands SMP before public release! Help us stress-test systems and report bugs.
questions: What is your Minecraft Java in-game username (IGN)?
What is your timezone or region?
Have you had prior experience testing Minecraft servers, mods, or plugins?
How many hours per week can you actively test and report bugs on Darklands SMP?
Why do you want to be a Beta Tester for Darklands SMP?

applications.name: Staff Application
applications.description: Apply to join the Darklands SMP moderation and helper team.
questions: What is your Minecraft Java in-game username (IGN)?
What timezone or region are you located in?
How long have you been playing on Minecraft SMPs, and how long on Darklands?
Have you had past staff or moderation experience? If so, where and what was your role?
How would you handle a situation where two players are aggressively arguing in chat?
Why do you want to join the Darklands SMP staff team?

applications.name: Builder Application
applications.description: Apply to build spawns, warps, dungeons, and landmarks for Darklands SMP.
questions: What is your Minecraft Java in-game username (IGN)?
What building styles do you specialize in (e.g. medieval, fantasy, modern, terraforming)?
Please provide links to screenshots or a portfolio of your builds.
Why do you want to build for Darklands SMP?
